main_visual_task: Wake a sleeping electric car in a dark garage as one thin light bar ignites across its front, while the camera performs one continuous slow push-in toward that light bar.

matched_cut.out_state: front light bar fully lit and centered head-on, dark garage, ready for S2 sunrise road

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same one silver-grey electric concept sedan with a smooth closed front fascia, one thin full-width LED light bar, flush door handles, aerodynamic covered wheels, dark panoramic glass roof, badge-free body
prompt_bible.environment_lock: quiet private garage before dawn, matte concrete floor and walls, one car alone, no people
prompt_bible.material_lock: brushed silver-grey paint with soft specular highlights, matte concrete, glass roof, LED light bar
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: very dim cool ambient darkness at start; the car's own thin LED light bar ignites and becomes the dominant warm-white key light; fixed light direction thereafter
prompt_bible.palette_lock: silver grey, graphite concrete, warm-white LED, deep black shadow
prompt_bible.lens_texture: photoreal cinema lens, 50mm look, natural highlight rolloff, no CGI geometry, no lens flares
prompt_bible.screen_direction: camera faces the car front dead-on; the light bar stays horizontal and centered
prompt_bible.audio_policy: near silence, faint electrical hum that rises slightly when the light bar ignites, soft room tone, no music, no voice

timeline.visual_state: the car sits in near-darkness as a faint centered silhouette
timeline.subject_action: nothing moves; one faint standby glow hints at the closed front fascia
timeline.camera_action: begin one continuous very slow push straight toward the front of the car
timeline.focus: center of the closed front fascia

timeline.visual_state: the thin full-width light bar begins to ignite from its center outward
timeline.subject_action: the light bar wakes segment by segment across the whole front width
timeline.camera_action: continue the same straight push-in at unchanged slow speed
timeline.focus: the spreading ignition point of the light bar
timeline.lighting_state: LED light becomes the dominant warm-white key in the dark garage
timeline.end_state: three quarters of the light bar glows

timeline.visual_state: the full light bar glows and its reflection paints a clean horizontal line on the concrete floor
timeline.subject_action: the light bar reaches steady full brightness; paint highlights rise along the hood edge
timeline.camera_action: continue only the same straight optical-axis push-in toward the light bar
timeline.focus: full-width light bar and its floor reflection
timeline.lighting_state: steady warm-white key from the car itself, background falls to black
timeline.end_state: front face fills more of frame, light bar steady

timeline.visual_state: head-on view of the lit front, light bar horizontal and centered, hood edge visible
timeline.subject_action: only micro-detail: specular highlight sits still on the hood; nothing else moves
timeline.end_state: symmetrical lit front near full frame

timeline.visual_state: the lit front face of the car centered in darkness
timeline.camera_action: camera completes the push-in and stops
timeline.focus: locked on the steady light bar
timeline.end_state: stable bright centered light bar on black, clean matched-cut endpoint

camera_plan.motivation: move the viewer toward the car exactly as its electric heart wakes, ending on the face of the energy itself
camera_plan.start_position: medium close-up dead-on to the car front in the dark garage
camera_plan.path: move straight forward along the optical axis toward the front light bar, no lateral motion
camera_plan.speed_curve: one constant very slow forward move with gentle deceleration across the final second
camera_plan.focus_transition: closed fascia to ignition point to full light bar and its floor reflection
camera_plan.end_position: close-up centered on the fully lit full-width light bar
camera_plan.axis_lock: dead-on frontal axis only; the light bar stays horizontal and centered; no orbit, no lateral move, no pullback
camera_plan.stop_condition: stop after the light bar is steady and the frame is still

first_frame: faint centered silhouette of a silver-grey electric sedan in a dark concrete garage
last_frame: steady thin full-width light bar centered on the badge-free silver-grey front face, darkness around it
